#The Painter

Back when the world had color-

When the sun shone warm and bright

When the wild wind smelled of wildflowers

When the world still had light....

We'd look at the sky - The Painter and I-

And take in the lovely sight.

Together we'd create adventures,

Laugh until our ribs were sore.

I'd lay on the grass while she painted clouds-

The leaves, the trees, and more.

But days would soon die, and The Painter and I-

Would have to break until Morn'

On the way back she held me close,

I could see in her eyes some tears.

She wanted to paint, to play, to dance.

As we'd done for all of those years.

We said Goodbye- The Painter and I-

And a tiny whimper I would hear.

I woke up the next morning,

Just like any other day.

I went to find her out on the hill.

But the sky was then grey.

She would be here soon, I hoped and prayed-

So I waited for hours.

Then I waited for days.

The dark took over and the sun went cold

The flowers all wilted and died

The trees were barren, dark and alone

And I began my lonely ride.
